title: skills: objectstack-automation says a subflow or map child resolves from the calling flow's package and its declared dependencies (ADR-0150 E1 Skills-docs follow-up)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQXLfvyB5R53VDm3Ka

Filing gate: ④ coordination node: the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` of child E1 #31672 of the epic #31527 (ADR-0150), named in E1's PR #31738. ⛔ Not a claim.
Business reason: inherited from the parent #31527. An AI agent authoring a package's flows reads `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`. After #31738 a `subflow` or `map` node's bare flow name resolves from the calling flow's package: its own flow, else the unique holder in its declared dependency closure plus `sys`, else a refusal naming every candidate. A child flow that only the environment holds, or that only an undeclared package holds, is refused. The skill does not say so today, so an agent writes a flow that validates and then fails when the node runs.
Reader: the `domain:skills` seat, after PR #31738 merges.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `subflow map package closure skill` (88; top hits #28840(closed) #27601(closed) #30806(open), none on point: older subflow work and the epic's parent).
class: d · type: Docs
Part of #31527. Blocked-by: #31672

## 维护者速读

自动化技能文档里子流程（subflow / map）那几行要补一句：子流程按调用它的流程所在的软件包及其声明的依赖解析，找不到或不在依赖里就会被拒绝。

## What to build

- `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`, the `subflow` / `map` rows: state the resolution rule above and the two refusals (environment-only holder, undeclared package holder), each with one example. The eval that exercises subflows gains a case.
